correctness.rationale: Over D8 four scalar transforms and a 2x2 block are explicitly derived. The determinant x²+y²−z²−w² applies over both fields and its real anisotropy on a three-rotation support explains the field gap. All 56 triple subsets lie in the three analyzed orbits. For support five, rank≤3 reduces to one scalar and a rank-one matrix; pair sums ±t force four singleton pairs from three, contradiction. General uncertainty covers remaining minima, and 16 exact Gaussian-integer witness checks verify every sharp upper value. No finite sample stands in for an infinite-amplitude argument.
